title: Human skill retention gate
event: AI agents can finish protected human work without a recorded human first pass and final judgment.
pattern: A green mechanical check is treated as if the protected skill was practiced.
structure: Agent instruction files and CI did not share one retention rule or a validator for it.
archetype: Shifting the Burden: the tool's completion replaces the human repetition the skill requires.
intervention: Publish the retention rule on every required agent surface and validate the config from a pinned, read-only workflow.
leading_indicators: The workflow exits 0 only when all 23 protected capabilities keep human first pass, final judgment, and evidence, and AI final authority stays false.
transfer: The same marker and validator pattern can guard other repositories that list protected capabilities.
